mission_10: The Module pattern uses an IIFE: (() => { let privateVar; return { publicMethod() {} }; })(). Variables inside the IIFE are private.
For the Validator, validate(data, schema) iterates over schema keys and runs each rule, collecting errors.
The Plugin system uses a Map to store plugins. Each plugin can register for hooks, and execute(hook, data) runs all plugins registered for that hook.
